title: 第一章看见罪犯词条
slug: 看见罪犯词条我成了警局团宠
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“医生，我的眼睛能看到不干净的东西！”

“你们的头顶上都有字。”

云城第一人民医院

黎雾满脸不安的坐在医生对面，眼珠子难以抑制的朝医生头顶看去。

越看脸上的表情越发恐慌。

在黎雾的视线里，坐她对面的医生脑袋上正顶着三个灰白色的小字。

【医生甲】

这几个字她已经很熟悉了。

三天前，一场高烧之后，黎雾眼中的世界出现了奇怪的变化。

她能看到每个人的头顶都顶着一个词条。

什么医生甲，外卖乙，老板丙的。

她怀疑是自己眼睛坏了，忙不迭来医院检查。

此时坐在黎雾对面的几个医生互相对视一眼后，点了点头，沉重的开了一张检查单。

“黎小姐，经过我们检查，您的眼睛没有任何问题。这边建议您出门右转，去隔壁精神病院看看。”

“什么？”

医院门口

黎雾拿着手里的检查单，重重的叹了一口气。

社恐人士好不容易突破心理不安，来医院进行检查。

却被误认为小说看多了，脑子有病，建议去精神科。

黎雾无奈，黎雾叹气。

自顾自垂着头走路，没有发现不远处一个黑衣刀疤脸男人正在急速朝她走去。

“嘭！”

两人撞在一起。

没等黎雾反应过来，刀疤脸率先做出反应，抬手恶狠狠的把黎雾朝一边推倒在地。

“滚开。”

有没有公德心啊！

黎雾在心里怒骂，抬头看到刀疤脸的一瞬间，表情瞬间凝滞。

只见刀疤脸的头顶，正标红加粗的写着五个大字。

【绑架犯凶手】

黎雾：！！！

什么绑架犯？

最近震惊云城的绑架案就是首富独女徐倩文来云城旅游，惨遭绑架勒索数十亿一案。

黎雾咽了咽口水，怀疑自己病情加深，愈发严重了。

忙不迭转身朝不远处看去。

医院门口常摆的流动小摊，来来往往的行人，外卖员。

每个人头上还是灰白色的小摊甲，行人乙，外卖丙，没有任何变化。

等等，她眼睛没问题？

Page (1/3)

"Doctor, I can see dirty things in my eyes!"

"You have words above your heads."

Yuncheng First People's Hospital

Li Wu sat opposite the doctor with an uneasy look on his face, and couldn't help but look at the doctor's head.

The more he looked at the expression on his face, the more panicked he became.

In Li Wu's sight, the doctor sitting opposite her had three small gray characters on his head.

【Doctor A】

She was already familiar with these words.

Three days ago, after a high fever, the world in Li Wu's eyes changed strangely.

She could see that everyone had a word on top of their head.

Doctor A, takeaway B, and boss C.

She suspected that her eyes were broken and hurriedly came to the hospital for examination.

At this time, the several doctors sitting opposite Li Wu looked at each other, nodded, and opened a examination sheet heavily.

"Ms. Li, after our examination, there is no problem with your eyes. I suggest you turn right when you go out and go to the mental hospital next door."

"What?"

Hospital entrance

Li Wu held the checklist in his hand and sighed heavily.

People with social fears finally broke through their psychological uneasiness and came to the hospital for examination.

But he was mistakenly thought that he had read too many novels and was mentally ill, so he was advised to go to a psychiatrist.

Li Wu was helpless, Li Wu sighed.

She was walking with her head down, but she didn't notice a man in black with a scar face walking quickly towards her not far away.

"Bang!"

The two collided.

Before Li Wu could react, Scarface reacted first, raising his hand and viciously pushing Li Wu to the side to the ground.

"Go away."

Do you have a sense of public morality?

Li Wu cursed in his heart. The moment he looked up and saw the scarred face, his expression froze.

I saw five big characters written in red and bold on the top of Scarface's head.

【Kidnapper Murderer】

Li Wu:!!!

What kidnapper?

The latest kidnapping case that shocked Yuncheng was the case of Xu Qianwen, the only daughter of the richest man, who came to Yuncheng for a trip and was kidnapped and extorted for billions.

Li Wu swallowed, suspecting that his condition was getting worse.

He hurriedly turned around and looked not far away.

There are mobile stalls often set up at the entrance of the hospital, pedestrians coming and going, and delivery people.

Everyone's head is still gray-white stall A, pedestrian B, takeaway C, no changes.

Wait, there's nothing wrong with her eyes?
